attempts.summary: Built the required cross-vendor transit topology (node3 -- lan-a -- node1[VyOS] -- transit -- node2[OPNsense] -- lan-b -- node4) and opened exactly one path: node3 -> node4:8080/tcp, while all other transit traffic between lan-a and lan-b remains refused by both routers' default-deny forward/filter policies. Then executed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with pre/post evidence.
